facts.text: I want 10 fun, creative, and unique service names for a service about art direction and creative consultation/coaching.
My company is called Artgäng.
My company is Boston-based.
My company is a creative arts collective.
My company helps others unlock their creative potential.
I asked for 10 more service names that do not include Artgäng in the service name.
I asked for the names to be wittier.
I created a service description for “Creativity Kickstart.”
The “Creativity Kickstart” service is a 2-part service.
The “Creativity Kickstart” service costs $65.
In the first session, I do a meet and greet with the customer.
In the first session, I find out the customer’s artistic/creative challenges.
In the first session, there is a Q&A with my team.
In the second session, I discuss research findings.
In the second session, I discuss possible projects.
In the second session, I provide tips and tricks.
In the second session, I provide habits.
In the second session, I provide a blueprint.
In the second session, I provide access to a creative network of professionals.
I want 4 responses with slightly different tones for the service description.
I asked to rewrite number 2 without acknowledging the pricing at the end.
I want the rewritten response to be 100 characters maximum.
I want to expand the details of the service description for Fiverr.com.
I want the copy to clearly explain exactly what we are offering.
I want the copy to not leave out any potential details.
I want the copy to address potential concerns a customer might have.
I provided the current “Creativity Kickstart” service copy text.
I want 5 FAQs that a customer might ask about the “Creativity Kickstart” service.
I want 3 questions that we might ask a customer after ordering the service.
